gse244832.allowed_use: Donor-level external-development RNA-to-ATAC profile evaluation only after all admission gates. It cannot train paired BABEL because its assays are different aliquots, not the same cell or nucleus.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 matrices, labels, target ATAC, preprocessing statistics, model fitting, feature changes, or calibration may enter a model scored on it.

gse289173.allowed_use: None for BABEL's active profile task because the sealed cohort has RNA but no ATAC truth.
gse289173.model_access: No outcomes or labels are available. Modality incompatibility prevents profile confirmation.

gse296875.allowed_use: Same-nucleus outer-fold local BABEL training and donor-held RNA-to-ATAC evaluation only if written code permission permits it and the loader is replaced with leakage-safe preprocessing.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define genes, peaks, normalization, model weights, hyperparameters, early stopping, or calibration. Held donors provide RNA only when RNA-to-ATAC is scored.

historical_checkpoint.chronology: The checkpoint was documented by October 2021 and its declared PBMC/colorectal corpus predates GSE244832, GSE296875, and GSE289173 releases.
historical_checkpoint.eligibility: Chronology supports target-label-unexposed status only after the archive MD5 matches and immutable object identity is recorded. It does not cure absent code or weight terms.
historical_checkpoint.feature_contract: Use only the checkpoint's exact rna_genes.txt and atac_bins.txt after genome-build and feature-coverage validation; no held-source union or refit.

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; evaluation at donor/cell-state pseudobulk only, never paired training
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; paired training allowed only after join validation and permissions

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; nuclei and peaks are not independent biological replicates.
rules.local_training: The upstream full-data normalization, clustering, and split path is prohibited. A permitted adapter must fit every transform inside outer-training donors.
rules.missingness: RNA-only inference is a designed source-to-target call and must not fabricate an all-zero ATAC input. Other missing states remain explicit in project manifests.
rules.status: No BABEL campaign may be scheduled until written permissions and all technical blockers are closed.
